description: This file defines the EditTagDialog class, a dialog UI component within an Android application for creating or editing tags. It manages user interactions for renaming or creating new tags, interfacing with a ViewModel and handling UI elements such as text input and buttons.

classes.name: EditTagDialog
classes.description: A dialog fragment for editing or creating tags, extending BaseDialog with a specific binding layout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog and retrieves the Tag object from arguments.

methods.name: createBinding
methods.description: Inflates the dialog's view binding using the provided LayoutInflater.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures the dialog's UI and behavior based on whether a Tag is being edited or a new one is being created.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the dialog with an optional Tag argument.
